PR-1.2 grid: all 1 <= J < L <= 2 floor(sqrt B) plus L in {B/8, B/4, B/2, B} (floors); J = L is trivial.
PR-1.1 windows: preregistered {2,3,5,8,floor(sqrt B),2 floor(sqrt B)} plus the extra windows.
